title: Reproducible diagnosis: two parts, one decision
summary: Use the versioned schedule to distinguish one metal part from one non-metal part without inventing observability.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Distinguish a metal part from a non-metal part with one memory that lives between two sensors.
Read a scheduled input timeline and predict the outputs before running it.

stages.title: Locate
stages.body: Use PartAtClassifier, MetalDetected, and PartAtDiverter in src/Conveyor.st and add MetalLatched.
stages.checkpoint: MetalLatched sets with classifier+metal and clears when the part reaches the diverter.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: The first part is metal and the second is non-metal.
stages.checkpoint: Expect diversion only for the first; Belt stays active for both.

stages.title: Read the schedule
stages.body: The JSON schedules classifier→diverter at {{t:20}}→{{t:30}} ms and {{t:50}}→{{t:70}} ms, with a {{t:10}} ms tick through {{t:80}} ms. Start is pressed only at {{t:0}} ms, so the program must hold the belt request.
stages.checkpoint: The three assertions are {{v:Conveyor.BeltCommand=true,Conveyor.DiverterCommand=true@30|AT@30 Belt=true/Diverter=true}}, {{v:Conveyor.BeltCommand=true,Conveyor.DiverterCommand=false@70|AT@70 Belt=true/Diverter=false}}, and NEVER Diverter=true with Belt=false.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then press {{ui:learn.check}}: The starter never latches metal for the diverter; hold the belt request after Start, latch metal at the classifier, and clear it only when the part reaches the diverter.
stages.checkpoint: Check reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson and lists every assertion that failed.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named ConveyorTwoParts and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Diagnose
stages.body: The Tests matrix proves the outputs of the simulation: compare the {{t:30}} and {{t:70}} ms samples.
stages.checkpoint: It does not prove or record inputs, physical parts, or the internal MetalLatched state.

stages.title: Limits
stages.body: Repeat the same scenario for a reproducible decision about the outputs of the simulation.
stages.checkpoint: What the assertions check is tested; nothing else is.

hints.text: The classifier and the diverter see the part at different instants, so remember what the classifier saw: MetalLatched sets with PartAtClassifier AND MetalDetected.

Clear MetalLatched once the part reaches the diverter, drive DiverterCommand from BeltCommand AND PartAtDiverter AND MetalLatched, and hold the belt request after the single Start press at {{t:0}} ms.

faultCases: The starter never latches metal for the diverter; hold the belt request after Start, latch metal at the classifier, and clear it only when the part reaches the diverter.
